summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Dynasty Dreams Trade Center & Waiver Wire engines. All 56 new tests passed (100%). All 65 existing tests passed (1 skipped). Total: 121/122 tests passed (99.2%). Trade and Waiver systems fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Trade Center implementation is solid with proper auth checks on all endpoints
Trade block prevents duplicate entries correctly
Trade accept/reject/withdraw properly validates user ownership (target vs proposer)
Trade voting system works with duplicate vote prevention
Waiver Wire FAAB budget tracking works correctly ($100 default, auto-initialized)
Budget validation prevents bids exceeding remaining FAAB
Waiver processing correctly awards to highest bidder
WebSocket broadcasting implemented for real-time updates (not tested - REST focus)
All existing features (auth, leagues, teams, players, drafts) continue to work

success_rate.backend: 99.2% (121/122 - 1 skipped due to single team in snake draft test)

seed_data_creation: Test leagues, teams, trades, and waiver claims created during testing via API
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Trade Center and Waiver Wire backend fully tested. All endpoints working:

TRADE BLOCK:
- POST /api/trade-block (add player/pick to trade block)
- GET /api/trade-block (list all items)
- DELETE /api/trade-block/{id} (remove item, validates ownership)

TRADES:
- POST /api/trades (create proposal with assets offered/requested)
- GET /api/trades (list with league_id, status, my_trades filters)
- GET /api/trades/{id} (get details)
- POST /api/trades/{id}/accept (target team only)
- POST /api/trades/{id}/reject (target team only)
- POST /api/trades/{id}/withdraw (proposer only)
- POST /api/trades/{id}/vote (approve/veto, prevents duplicates)

WAIVERS:
- GET /api/waivers/available (with search/position filter)
- POST /api/waivers/claim (FAAB bid, validates budget)
- GET /api/waivers/claims (with league_id, my_claims, status filters)
- DELETE /api/waivers/claims/{id} (cancel pending, validates ownership)
- GET /api/waivers/budget (FAAB tracking, auto-initializes $100)
- GET /api/waivers/order (waiver priority by inverse standings)
- GET /api/waivers/history (processed claims)
- POST /api/waivers/process (commissioner only, highest bid wins)

WebSocket events broadcast but not tested (REST API focus).
